title: RBAC role template catalog and adaptive intake routing for enterprise admin requests
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce cycle time and cognitive load for enterprise admin/access requests by providing a curated RBAC role template catalog and an adaptive intake router that classifies requests (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC changes, org policy) and surfaces automated guidance or routing to the appropriate team (Console, Identity, Customer Success, Security).

Scope: 1) Design canonical RBAC role templates and mapping to common enterprise personas (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Read-only Auditor, Support Agent). 2) Build intake classifier rules + priority scoring to auto-route requests and suggest existing templates. 3) UX copy and inline guidance for self-serve customers. 4) Telemetry hooks to measure time-to-resolution, manual overrides, and template reuse.

Out of scope: full SAML implementation work, SCIM connector engineering, and custom role authoring UI (those are separate engineering epics). This ticket is focused on taxonomy, routing heuristics, and product requirements for a minimum viable routing+template experience.
acceptance_criteria: Intake classifier that tags incoming admin requests into one of: RBAC-change, SSO/SAML-onboarding, SCIM-sync, org-policy, privileged-onboarding with >= 85% precision in samples

A role template catalog with at least 6 curated templates (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Support Agent, Read-only Auditor, Model Ops, Dedicated Admin) documented with permissions, guardrails, and suggested justifications
Routing rules that auto-assign requests to the correct internal queue or surface a self-serve template suggestion to the customer in >50% of new requests
Telemetry dashboard showing template suggestions accepted vs overridden and median time-to-resolution baseline
Docs and Figma screens reviewed by Design and Security; signoff recorded in comments
